svg.text: vLLM TPU Hardware Plugin - Unified JAX to XLA Lowering - PyTorch + Flax on Google TPU
L2 - vLLM V1 Engine + tpu-inference Hardware Plugin
Scheduler + KV cache manager + API server
All models lowered via JAX - ~20% throughput gain
Single program - XLA auto-shards across TPU
Pure function model: weights + KV + inputs in
Graph capture: warm all shape buckets at init
2. Torchax wrapper (vllm nn.Module - JAX arrays via torch_view)
Auto-route: tpu-inference model if exists, else Torchax
VllmModelWrapper handles KV cache for torch path
Paged KV blocks - shared by Flax and Torchax paths
Fused KV scatter + attention - hides DMA latency
Shared JAX sampler for all model paths
TP / PP / DP / EP via JAX shard_map + device mesh
Hardware plugin: same vLLM UX - TPU-native kernels underneath - PyTorch devs need zero code changes via Torchax
L4 - Pallas TPU Kernels & XLA Compilation
All paths converge on JAX arrays + shared RPA V3 kernel + JAX sampler
Step 1: vLLM scheduler output - prepare_inputs() as jax.Array (shared buffer)
Step 2: Route model - Flax NNX native OR Torchax functional_call OR vLLM upstream
Step 3: Attention via RPA V3 - jax_view(torch) - kernel - torch_view(jax) if needed
Step 4: XLA JIT execute on TPU mesh - SPMD auto-partition across cores
Step 5: JAX sampler - return tokens to vLLM EngineCore - stream to client
Torchax: torch.Tensor is a view over jax.Array - every torch op lowers to JAX/XLA
No code changes for PyTorch model defs - same vLLM llama.py works on TPU
Ragged Paged Attention V3 + SPMD TPU Design
Primary TPU backend in vLLM and SGLang - arXiv:2604.15464 - up to 86% MBU decode
Old: GPU-like multi-worker per chip - torch_xla / PTXLA path
New: SPMD - write for one device, XLA partitions across TPU mesh
RPA also powers SGLang-JAX and DFlash diffusion-style speculative decoding on TPU
vllm-project/tpu-inference - TPU v5e/v6e/v7x - GCE - bfloat16 - Apache 2.0 - docs.vllm.ai/projects/tpu
Init path: pip tpu-inference - vllm serve - TpuJaxPlatform - warm JIT buckets - init paged KV pool
Step path: schedule batch - route model path - RPA V3 forward - JAX sample - stream - repeat
Sources: vllm-project/tpu-inference - vllm.ai blog 2025-10-16 - arXiv:2604.15464 RPA - docs.vllm.ai/projects/tpu
